
```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- readCaption("tbl.DEQ.PGA")
Target <- .currentTarget("ID.target")
ID.target <- .resolveIDTarget(
  DEQTable,
  "DEQ.PGA.qmd",
  base = TRUE,
  target = Target,
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target")
)
if (!exists("Standard.target") || !length(Standard.target)) Standard.target <- "GISTM"
if (!exists("Stage.target") || !length(Stage.target)) Stage.target <- "Operation"
if (!exists("Vs30.target") || !length(Vs30.target)) Vs30.target <- Vs30.gmdp
if (!exists("PSA_Units") || !length(PSA_Units)) PSA_Units <- "g"
root <- here::here()
```

&nbsp;

```{r}
#| include: true
#| label: tbl-deq-pga
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP |> sprintf(Standard.target, Stage.target, paste(siteID.target, collapse = ", "), PSA_Units, paste(sort(Vs30.target), collapse = ", "))
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "tbl", "DEQ.PGA.R"))
TBL
```

&nbsp;

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(Standard.target, Stage.target, Vs30.target, PSA_Units, CAP, ID.target)
if (exists("Target", inherits = FALSE) && length(Target)) ID.target <- Target
rm(list = intersect("Target", ls()))
```
